artworks.title: 14 Juillet.  Illumination de la Place de la République
artworks.artist: Auguste Lepère after Henri Louis Scott
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession and a monumental statue. The image shows a scene of a public celebration or event around a grand stone statue with a figure holding a torch. The area is filled with a large crowd of people carrying lamps or lanterns. The monument has classical architectural details and decorative elements, including plaques and inscriptions reading 'GLOIRE A LA FRANCE.' Flags are held by the crowd, along with columns adorned with stars and circular motifs. The sky is darkened with stylized clouds, and there are strands of light symbolizing illumination or fireworks.

artworks.title: 14 Juillet.  Illumination du Palais du Trocadéro
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural structure from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The focus is on a large building with intricate archways and towers. Flowing fountains and sculpted horse statues are visible below the building. The illustration features detailed strokes, resembling an engraving or etching, emphasizing architectural and decorative details. The color scheme is mainly monochrome, with shades of grey and black highlighting scattered lights against the night sky. A dense crowd gathers near us, while trees and additional architectural elements can be seen in the distance against a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Le 14 Juillet.  Illumination de la Seine du Pont Neuf au Pont au Change
artworks.description: The image shows a nighttime celebration along a river with a cityscape in the background. The scene includes grand baroque architecture, bustling riverbanks with boats lit up, a domed rooftop with statues, a tree with lanterns, and a bridge arching over the river. The background also features old tall buildings and fireworks lighting up the sky. The image is a detailed engraving with fine lines and cross-hatching for texture and depth, using a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: Exposition de Nice
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a grand architectural structure with surrounding landscape and activity. It features an elaborate building with domes, arches, and towers on elevated terrain. In the foreground, there is a waterfall and groups of people socializing. Lush trees and bushes surround the building, with clouds in the sky. The design details indicate a late 19th-century style, possibly signifying cultural or social importance.

artworks.title: La Neige À Paris
artworks.description: The image shows a gathering of people on a wooded slope by a river filled with illuminated boats. The opposite bank is lined with dense trees and there are structures emitting smoke. The painting features an impressionistic style with swirling patterns in the sky and water, in shades of black, white, and gray. Bright spots of light give the scene a lively and festive atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Violinist
artworks.medium: black and white chalk with graphite on blue paper
artworks.description: The image displays the upper body of a person in a seated position, drawn in profile. The individual appears relaxed with their head slightly tilted forward, closed eyes, and a hint of a mustache. The neatly styled hair is combed to the side, and the person is wearing a high-collared garment, potentially a suit or coat. They are depicted holding a violin against their shoulder, with the bow held in their hand. The background is plain, focusing on the subject of the drawing.

artworks.title: Avalanche in an Alpine Landscape
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on blue paper (verso)
artworks.description: The image shows a downward perspective, appearing to be from a mountainside looking into a valley. The horizon is partly visible but mostly hidden by mountains and trees. The artwork features light and sketchy brushstrokes with graphite or pencil marks adding texture to trees and rocks, giving depth to the scene. The color palette is mostly monochromatic, using shades of gray to depict shadowed and sunlit areas. Closest to the viewer are rocks and vegetation leading down to the valley, with the scene transitioning into thick woodland and rocky slopes in the background.

artworks.title: Two Studies of Madame Lemmen
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke
artworks.description: The image shows two people facing each other. One person has long hair tied back and is dressed in a long gown, while the other has short hair and is also wearing a long gown. The background features vague furniture elements, giving a soft, textured appearance. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The tones are muted, with shading in dark tones on a lighter background. The artwork appears to be a charcoal or pencil drawing on paper, signed in the bottom left corner with a date.

artworks.title: Battery Knox
artworks.description: The image shows a clearing with several pieces of artillery, including cannons and wheeled guns, arranged in a semi-circle facing a wide river. The horizon is in the middle distance, where the river meets wooded hills. Trees are scattered throughout the scene, framing the clearing. The photograph is in sepia tones, with a clear sky.

artworks.title: Landscape near Williams College
artworks.dimensions:
image: 5 3/4 x 7 13/16 in. (14.6 x 19.9 cm), oval
mount: 11 x 14 in. (28 x 35.5 cm)
artworks.description: The image displays a natural landscape with a dominant tall tree to the right. A stream runs through the lush vegetation in the foreground, and other trees and shrubs are visible on the left side. The horizon is faintly visible in the upper part of the image. The color scheme is sepia, giving a warm tone to the scene.

artworks.title: Waterfall near Williams College
artworks.dimensions:
image: 7 11/16 x 5 3/4 in. (19.6 x 14.6 cm), oval
mount: 14 x 11 in. (35.6 x 27.9 cm)
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky landscape with various geological formations. The view is from above, looking down into a narrow crevice surrounded by large rocks. There are sparse vegetation and small plants growing among the rocks. The color palette is mainly earthy tones of brown and gray. The rocks display a variety of patterns and textures, with light and shadow creating a dramatic effect.

artworks.title: Christ Enthroned, with Two Angels
artworks.creditLine: Tennity Fund, New Century Fund and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image features a seated figure on a throne-like seat. The figure has a full beard and curly hair, wears a crown, and is surrounded by a halo. The person wears elaborate robes, holds a scepter in one hand, and an orb with a cross in the other. Two smaller figures, potentially angels, stand on either side. One holds a scroll, the other adjusts drapery. The background has a detailed curtain. The artwork is done in a detailed, linear style typical of engravings.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross between the Virgin and Saint John
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene with two figures standing beside the cross. The figure on the cross has outstretched arms nailed to the horizontal beam. The two figures flanking the cross wear robes with elaborate folds. The background shows a landscape with hills, trees, and distant buildings. The cross is mounted on a mound, with symbolism at the base in the form of a skull and bones. The sky is filled with rolling clouds. The style is typical of the Northern Renaissance printmaking tradition.

artworks.title: Death of Cleopatra
artworks.dimensions: sheet (irregular hexagon): 11.2 x 15.1 cm (4 7/16 x 5 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying down on a textured surface, possibly grass. They are resting on their right elbow, with their left hand near their midsection holding an object. The person's facial features are serene, with a rounded face framed by hair covered by a cloth. The individual is unclothed, and there are no signs of jewelry. The background includes hills, a river, buildings, and a tree to the right of the person.

artworks.title: River Landscape with Two Buildings
artworks.description: The image shows a river or waterway with a stone tower and adjacent building on the left, along with a bridge leading towards the center. Rolling hills and mountains meet the sky in the distance. The brushstrokes resemble fine lines used for intricate details and textures. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of sepia or light brown. A tree on the right side and architectural elements like buildings and a bridge are depicted with solid lines. The landscape recedes into the background, offering depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Wooded Cliffs along a Stream
artworks.medium: black chalk with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape seen from a slightly elevated angle, showing rocky terrain and a dense forest. The scene features trees on stone cliffs with the horizon hidden by foliage, hinting at an expansive natural setting. The detailed brushstrokes emphasize leaf texture and rock layers. The color scheme includes earthy browns and soft grays, creating a tranquil atmosphere. A water body near the viewer reflects the rocks and surrounding vegetation.

artworks.title: Saint George Killing the Dragon
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund and Edward E. MacCrone Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a knight on horseback confronting a dragon in a forest. The knight, in armor, raises his sword towards the dragon. The dragon is snarling and coiled in the foreground, surrounded by trees and rough terrain. In the background, there is a castle on a hill with smoke rising. The drawing features detailed cross-hatching and line work reminiscent of prints from the Renaissance period, with dramatic trees and cloudy skies creating a sense of movement and tension in the scene.

artworks.title: Kalaat el Hosn (Castle of the Knights, Syria)
artworks.description: The image shows ancient stone ruins, possibly a castle or fortress. A narrow stone path leads to a central round stone tower. The horizon is low, encircled by more ruins and distant landforms against the sky. The photograph likely features a sepia or monochromatic tone emphasizing the stone's texture and age. The color scheme is muted with brown and beige hues. Large rectangular stone blocks line the pathway, while crumbling walls extend into the distance.

artworks.title: Portrait of Woman and Child
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. and Joyce Menschel Fund and The Sarah and William L Walton Fund
artworks.description: Two people are in the image, with one seated and the other standing beside them. The seated person has their hair pulled back and wears a dress with a patterned trim and white collar. Their face is in profile, showing defined features, and their hair is styled in a braid. The standing person leans toward the seated person, with their face slightly blurred and turned sideways. They wear a dress with a wide collar and patterned fabric. Both are outdoors with blurred foliage in the background. The seated person holds a flower and wears an earring.

artworks.title: Portrait of Woman and Child
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals from the waist up. The person on the left is seated while the person on the right is standing and leaning towards the seated individual. The seated person has dark, neatly styled hair pulled back and is wearing a pair of earrings. They have a composed expression and are dressed in a dark-colored garment with white collar and long sleeves. They are holding a white flower. The standing individual has hair pulled back and seems to be interacting with the seated person. They are wearing a light-colored, striped dress with a shawl-like design around the shoulders. Both individuals are set against a blurred foliage backdrop.

artworks.title: Head of a Man
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a person's upper body in profile view, facing left. The person has a prominent nose, with subtle lines around their mouth suggesting a smile. The hair is styled in an 18th-century fashion, possibly tied or queued. The person wears a tricorn hat with a decorative element at the front, a coat with a high collar, and two visible buttons. The sketch is done on textured paper, providing a simple background that emphasizes the detailed line work.

artworks.title: Figures on Top of a Hill, Overlooking the Sea
artworks.medium: graphite on two sheets of wove paper (consecutive sketchbook pages)
artworks.description: The image shows several figures on a hillside, with a low horizon revealing a distant landscape. The sketch features loose brushwork with fluid pencil strokes. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing the drawing's sketch-like quality. Figures are depicted standing and seated, facing different directions, suggesting gentle activity or leisure.

artworks.title: Les Courses de Deauville
artworks.medium: graphite with pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a street scene with a central carriage being drawn by horses, a man seated inside and a woman standing beside. On the right, there is a horse tied to a cart with a man nearby, and further right, there is a stove with a pot emitting steam or smoke. The sketchy lines and monochrome color palette give an impression of an old-fashioned lively scene.

artworks.title: A Basket of Spring Flowers
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a basket filled with black and white flowers, intricately detailed with leaves and petals. The basket sits on a surface, with flowers extending upwards. A bee is shown near the flowers in the lower right corner.
